userStories.title: Version Detail Page with PDF Viewer
PDF Canvas Annotation System
userStories.description: Allow users to draw annotations directly on PDF pages with freehand pen, text, checkmarks, and highlights
acceptanceCriteria: Canvas overlay on PDF viewer captures drawing input
Drawing tools: pen (freehand), text, checkmark stamp, highlight
Annotations stored as vector data in database (new annotations table)
Annotations render on top of PDF at correct positions
Annotations linked to specific version and page number
Support for different colors (at minimum: red, blue, black)
Clear/undo functionality for annotations
bun run build passes without errors
userStories.context: Raffy (designer) needs visual markup like checkmarks, strikethroughs, and text notes directly on menu PDFs. See wine list example with year/price changes marked up.

userStories.title: Edit Tags on Existing Menus
userStories.description: Allow editing tags on menus after creation
acceptanceCriteria: Menu detail page shows current tags
Edit button opens tag selection dialog
Can add/remove tags from existing menus
PATCH /api/menus/[id] endpoint supports tagIds update
bun run build passes without errors
